_doc: The garden minigames the title's 'Play with your Boki' picker can list (MinigameHub). member = the Home variable holding the game (unset on a base that doesn't have it, so it is not listed); rule = the one line shown under the name. Each game exposes use().

games.name: The Dash
games.rule: Cheer your Boki on with three timed presses; the fastest one home wins.

games.name: Stump Shove
games.rule: Two Boki push a stump; Power against Guard decides who tips it.

games.name: Seek
games.rule: Sniff the scent basket, then follow your Boki's nose to the hidden find.

games.name: Spark Volley
games.rule: Bat a spark across the log; Speed and Focus win the point.
